recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, shirtless male figure with tattoos stands in a desaturated, high-contrast urban street setting. The background features low-income housing and parked cars in a muted, dark sepia wash, while the foreground is anchored by bold, weathered block lettering and ornamental flourishes.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via lighting and saturation
Symmetry between the central figure and flanking graphic icons
Texture harmony between skin tattoos and distressed typography
coreInvariants: Desaturated color palette with warm brown/sepia undertones
High-contrast lighting on the central figure's musculature
Distressed, weathered texture applied to all foreground elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-shot of a male figure, occupying the vertical center and approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale horizontal text block across the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face down the torso to the high-contrast white text, then outward to the flanking icons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, atmospheric space at the top and bottom corners, filled with subtle urban details and ornamental scrollwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and muted sepia tones in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, desaturated skin tones with high-key highlights on the torso.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the primary typography and graphic icons.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall; value is used to define form, with deep blacks in the shadows and bright whites in the text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Eroded edges to simulate stencil or street-worn paint

composition.scale: Large, spanning nearly the full width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face paired with small, clean sans-serif metadata blocks.
graphicDevices: Dark ornamental scrollwork in the lower corners

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed block feel
Correct proportions and clean skeleton for weathering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, desaturated urban street scene at dusk featuring a shirtless, tattooed man centered in the frame. Apply a sepia-toned high-contrast filter with deep shadows and bright highlights on the skin. Include dark ornamental filigree in the bottom corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text across the lower third in off-white. Apply a heavy 'eroded' or 'grunge' texture to the letters. Flank the text with two small, symmetrical white graphic icons.

verificationChecks: Is the text weathered and distressed?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, black, and off-white?
Does the text overlap the subject slightly?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the background urban detail
postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'weathered' look of the white text
Ensure the background is sufficiently desaturated
Confirm the presence of ornamental corner elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Urban Portrait + High Contrast Sepia + Condensed Distressed Display Type + Symmetrical Framing Icons
